title: Motion Planning
description: Follow a Franka arm’s path from endpoint poses to an optimized trajectory. Inspect the factor graph, solver iterations, and joint motion.

title: Contact Labels
description: Inspect reference-derived stationary-contact training targets from world-frame sole motion on three SSIO G1 snippets.

title: Contact Initialization
description: Inspect contact-pose initialization on three SSIO snippets using max-product support labels and independently selectable upright, motion, and height priors.

title: Contact vs IK
description: Compare contact and inverse-kinematics initialization and recorded CM-Opt iterations on three ten-second G1 walking snippets.

title: Kinematics
description: Inspect a full G1 trajectory with contact initialization, Gal3 IMU aiding, loop closure, stationary-contact weights, factor errors, and foot slip.

title: SCATE UR5
description: Replay SCATE on a UR5: an obstacle discovered online is avoided by re-solving after every step, beside a blind run that hits it. Inspect the replanned paths, the obstacle estimate, and clearances.
